description.narrative: Overall Programme Objective: To support the sustainable transition of partner local selfgovernment units (LSGUs) in Bosnia and Herzegovina. This will be achieved through: 1) Improved Environmental Governance: By enhancing capacities and resources in BiH for efficient and effective implementation of the environmental strategy and by 2) Effective Local Transition Measures: By creating and implementing effective local transition measures and policies, thus contributing to better living conditions for citizens in coal regions in BiH. Two Intermediate Outcomes: Improved environmental sustainability and resilience of partner LSGUs in BiH Implementation of systemic transition measures aligned with the Green Agenda, driving inclusive and sustainable local development Three Immediate Outcomes: Improved policy framework and financing for sustainable transition Enhanced skills and knowledge of local stakeholders utilizing Swedish expertise Raised awareness and acceptance for sustainability and just transition

Programme “Sustainable Transition of Bosnia and Herzegovina (BiH SuTra)” aims to improve country-wide approach and national and local capacities to implement efficiently and effectively environmental and sustainable transition policies in BiH. The Programme consists of 2 Components, Component 1 – Environmental Governance & Capacity Building, with a duration of 60 months, and Component 2 – Supporting the Transition of Coal Regions in BiH, with a duration of 36 months, which will be implemented in parallel with Component 1 from the beginning. The Programme builds on the momentum created by the predecessor project that the Stockholm Environment Institute (SEI) implemented with the financial support of Sida – “Bosnia and Herzegovina’s Environmental Strategy (BIH ESAP 2030+)”,. The programme considers the lessons learned from BIH ESAP 2030+ and its established processes, structure, and extensive stakeholder network.

Programmet "Hållbar omställning i Bosnien och Hercegovina (BiH SuTra)" syftar till att förbättra den landsomfattande strategin och den nationella och lokala kapaciteten för att effektivt och ändamålsenligt genomföra politik för miljön och den hållbara omställningen i Bosnien och Hercegovina. Programmet består av två komponenter, komponent 1 - Miljöförvaltning och kapacitetsuppbyggnad, med en varaktighet på 60 månader, och komponent 2 - Stöd till Bosnien och Hercegovinas kolregioners omställning, med en varaktighet på 36 månader. Komponent 2 kommer från start att genomföras parallellt med komponent 1. Programmet bygger vidare på det som skapades av det föregångsprojekt som Stockholm Environment Institute (SEI) genomförde med finansiellt stöd från Sida - "Bosniens och Hercegovinas miljöstrategi (BIH ESAP 2030+)". Programmet tar hänsyn till lärdomarna från BIH ESAP 2030+ och det projektets etablerade processer, struktur och omfattande nätverk av intressenter.

Though Project Component 1 (PC1) related to Environmetal Governence is currently paused, due to delays in adoption of BIH Environmental strategy (BIH ESAP), the project continue to providing a support to adoption process of BIH ESAP 2030, in accordance with received comments from Republika Srpska and current state of play. This process is very much influenced by current political situation in BIH which is difficult and complex. In November 2023 MOFTER intiated the thired official procedure of obtaining opinions from entities and Brcko District. FBIH and BD promptely provided positive opinions, whilst the process is stopped by Republika Srpska again, this time due to comment recieved by Secretariat for Legislation of RS. No resolution have been reached by now. As to Project Component 2 (PC2) related to Supporting the Transition of Coal Regions in BIH, the following has been achieved: Initiating a partnership with 4 four local selfgovernment (LSGUs) units in Bosnia and Herzegovina (Banovici, Breza, Zivinice, and Ugljevik), by adopting the local decision on respective government councils to be part of the BiH SuTra project and signing the Memorandum of Understanding (MoU). Supporting the official establishment of formal teams for transitional planning in LSGUs, with 20 committed people to support the cooperation with SEI. Preparing Method of Work documents that contain a methodological approach to transition management based on literature review and best practices. Agreeing on a way forward in line with the local framework for planning in Bosnia and Herzegovina. Given the differences between the regulatory frameworks of local governments units in FBiH and RS, the most feasible approach for the Programme was to support the preparation of the Operational Plans for Sustainable Transition, which will directly stem from the broader planning exercise. Following the initial questionnaire, subsequent participatory 2050 visioning events drew in over 100 individuals directly participating in onsite events throughout October and November. The visions formulated during these sessions will serve as the foundation for the preparation of the transitional plan and its five development pathways (decarbonization, circular economy, decrease of pollution, sustainable agriculture and biodiversity). The Communication and Engagement Strategy have been developed and refined in early 2024 to better fit project plans for the year. This strategy will help project to communicate the progress with local partners and involve key stakeholders effectively. The BiH SuTra website and Facebook profile have been developed and up and running serving as a platform for the latest news and updates on the program. Comprehensive gender equality, social equity and poverty (gesep)focused situation analysis, complemented by an indepth baseline data collection have been done, followed by gesepintegration into preworkshop surveys and support for the visioning exercise.
